expected_root_cause: stringToStringValue.Set parses entries and writes into the target map without first initializing it. When StringToStringVar is given a nil default map, the first assignment panics.
fix_summary: Allocate the target map in Set when it is nil before inserting parsed key-value entries, and add a nil-default regression test.
curation_notes: PR #506 adds TestS2SNilDefault and initializes the target map in the production Set method; the buggy SHA is the parent of that functional fix commit.
